# Deliberate breaking API changes CI allows, one per line, copied from the
# oasdiff error or warning (see "API contract" in AGENTS.md). Empty unless a
# removal is under review.
GET /exercises added `#/components/schemas/ExercisePage, #/components/schemas/ExerciseBatch` to the response body `anyOf` list for the response status `200`
GET /exercises the response's body `type` changed from `object` to `any` for status `200`
GET /exercises removed the required property `data` from the response with the `200` status
GET /exercises removed the required property `hasMore` from the response with the `200` status
GET /exercises removed the required property `total` from the response with the `200` status
